tool_args.rationale: The fresh-confirmation failure shows that an exact training fit is insufficient. Additional trajectory observations can constrain the base response and threshold loss before another model is submitted.

considered_alternatives.option: Revise and confirm another threshold-avalanche model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The previous model fit the eight training rows exactly but failed fresh confirmation; the correlated inputs leave the loss mechanism underdetermined.
Already acquired; its three observations exposed the loss but did not identify its functional form.
One smooth mechanism was refuted, but there is no evidence of non-stationary oscillations or that all stationary smooth mechanisms fail.
It is not informative about the competing mechanisms.
